name: Ammihud
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Absalom fled, and the watchman saw much people coming, and Jonadab confirmed the king's sons had come as he said. The king's sons came, lifted up their voice and wept, and the king and all his servants wept very sore. Absalom fled to Talmai the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur, and David mourned for his son every day, and was there three years; and the soul of David longed to go forth to Absalom, being comforted concerning Amnon since he was dead.

note.label: 2 Samuel 13: Amnon Forces Tamar and Absalom Slays Amnon
